content.thinking: The stats window is capped at 7 days and 1 hour.

Daily figures for January 7 differ slightly between earlier and current pulls. Impressions shifted from 17,373 to 17,506. Resolution engagements changed from 32 to 36.

The final data pull is the source of truth. Daily spend for offer ix4yj from January 2 to 12 totals 173,858,763 micros. The first seven days sum to 209,195,704. The last four days sum to 86,483,874. This matches the promoted tweet total for the January 9–13 window.

Total offer spend is $383.05. Offer link clicks total 149 across the two periods. Impressions for January 2–8 sum to 110,959. Impressions for January 9–12 sum to 127,506.

Offer impressions total 238,465. Resolution j1myw spend for January 2–7 is $63.43 million. January 7 impressions revised from 4,047 to 4,479.

Resolution j1myw link clicks total 25. Campaign impressions reach 277,869. Total spend is $446.48. Overall CPC is $2.57. Offer CPC is $2.57. Resolution CPC is $2.54. The resolution cost per click was slightly lower because the campaign paused before the later higher spend days.

Resolution spend split into two phases. Early days cost $2.31 per click. Later days cost $3.26. The campaign stayed within its $450 budget and finished with roughly $3.52 unspent. The final day underspent slightly. The campaign expired on schedule.

Confirmed the offer total is $383 million.

The campaign ran from Saturday, January 2 to Tuesday, January 12, UK time. Total spend was $446.48 across 277,869 impressions and 174 link clicks. The offer and resolution posts delivered $383.05 and $63.43 respectively.

content.text:
The New Year push has ended. From 2 January through 12 January 2027 (UK time) it spent **$446.48**, delivered **277,869 impressions**, and drove **174 link clicks** to https://thimblepot.co.uk/new-year.

| Ad group | Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Offer post, UK 18+ mobile | New year, new pots | $383.05 | 238,465 | 149 |
| Resolution post, UK 18+ mobile | Resolution wobble | $63.43 | 39,404 | 25 |
| **Total** | | **$446.48** | **277,869** | **174** |

X cannot count installs, because there is no pixel and this was a website-click campaign. Link clicks are the count of people who reached the landing page.

The campaign is expired and is not spending. Both approved posts ran to UK adults on iOS and Android, aimed at family, parenting, and personal finance. The offer post was the stronger route to the page, so on 8 January the resolution post was paused and the rest of the $450 cap went to the offer post. About $3.52 of the budget was left unspent when the schedule ended.
